items.q: And, of course, you know that Claude at the time was managing me. And he had access to the studio. In fact, he was arranging for Andre Kostelanetz at the time.

ctx.x: why the discographic material (unintelligible) is a little bit confusing, because it does appear under so many people's names like Benny Carter, as I was saying before and Teddy Wilson.
Well, you know, "Gone With The Wind" was my very first accruity. And I hadn't reached the stature of getting a label of my own yet -- I mean a name of my own yet.
And, of course, you know that Claude at the time was managing me. And he had access to the studio. In fact, he was arranging for Andre Kostelanetz at the time.
